title: Refraction Studio training
data: Synthetic P and SH shot records generated by Refraction Studio, and the built-in sample project; no customer data.

segments.text: Welcome to the Refraction Studio training video from QuakeLogic. In about six minutes you will take a set of seismic refraction shot records to a velocity model, Vs30 and a finished report.
segments.say: Welcome to the Refraction Studio training video from Quake Logic. In about six minutes you will take a set of seismic refraction shot records to a velocity model, V s 30, and a finished report.

segments.text: Refraction Studio opens on the start page. Start a new project, open one, import a survey, or explore the built-in sample: a complete P and SH survey. Everything runs on your own computer, with no account and no activation.
segments.say: Refraction Studio opens on the start page. Start a new project, open one, import a survey, or explore the built in sample: a complete P and S H survey. Everything runs on your own computer, with no account and no activation.

segments.text: Start a new project and describe the site. These details appear on the report cover and in the audit record. The workflow on the left takes you through every step, and each step shows its status.
segments.say: Start a new project and describe the site. These details appear on the report cover and in the audit record. The workflow on the left takes you through every step, and each step shows its status.

segments.text: On the Import page, choose files or a whole folder of SEG-2 or SEG-Y records. Every file is inspected before anything is added: the format, the traces, the sample interval and the source position from the headers.
segments.say: On the Import page, choose files, or a whole folder of S E G 2 or S E G Y records. Every file is inspected before anything is added: the format, the traces, the sample interval, and the source position from the headers.

segments.text: Validation lists anything unusual. Here channel 30 of one shot is flat, so its geophone was probably disconnected. Nothing is repaired silently: tick the correction you approve, then import. The original files are stored unchanged inside the project.
segments.say: Validation lists anything unusual. Here, channel thirty of one shot is flat, so its geophone was probably disconnected. Nothing is repaired silently: tick the correction you approve, then import. The original files are stored unchanged inside the project.

segments.text: Geometry shows the line: geophones, shot points and the ground profile. Positions and elevations recorded in the file headers are used automatically. You can edit the spread, the channel roles and the shots, or paste a surveyed ground profile.
segments.say: Geometry shows the line: geophones, shot points, and the ground profile. Positions and elevations recorded in the file headers are used automatically. You can edit the spread, the channel roles, and the shots, or paste a surveyed ground profile.

segments.text: The Waveforms page shows each shot gather. Hover over a trace for its details, zoom with the mouse wheel, and step through the shots with the arrows. The amplitude spectrum helps you choose filters.
segments.say: The Waveforms page shows each shot gather. Hover over a trace for its details, zoom with the mouse wheel, and step through the shots with the arrows. The amplitude spectrum helps you choose filters.

segments.text: Processing is a list of steps applied to copies of the traces; the raw data never change. Remove the DC offset and, if surface waves obscure the first breaks, add a causal high-pass filter. Every step can be reordered, switched off or undone.
segments.say: Processing is a list of steps applied to copies of the traces; the raw data never change. Remove the D C offset, and if surface waves obscure the first breaks, add a causal high pass filter. Every step can be reordered, switched off, or undone.

segments.text: On the P picks page, press Pick automatically. Refraction Studio picks the first arrival on every trace and gives each pick a confidence, with its reasons.
segments.say: On the P picks page, press Pick automatically. Refraction Studio picks the first arrival on every trace, and gives each pick a confidence, with its reasons.

segments.text: Accept the high-confidence picks, then review the rest. Click a trace to place or move a pick, nudge it with the arrow keys and press Enter to accept. Manual picks are never overwritten, and the travel-time plot updates as you work.
segments.say: Accept the high confidence picks, then review the rest. Click a trace to place or move a pick, nudge it with the arrow keys, and press Enter to accept. Manual picks are never overwritten, and the travel time plot updates as you work.

segments.text: On the Velocity model page, choose the number of layers and press Suggest layer assignment. Check the crossovers on the travel-time plot, then apply the delay-time method. The layered model gives each layer's velocity and the depth to the refractor under every geophone.
segments.say: On the Velocity model page, choose the number of layers, and press Suggest layer assignment. Check the crossovers on the travel time plot, then apply the delay time method. The layered model gives each layer's velocity, and the depth to the refractor under every geophone.

segments.text: For a gradational model, run tomography. The inversion stops when the misfit matches the pick uncertainty. Cells below the depth of investigation are hatched, because the data do not constrain them.
segments.say: For a gradational model, run tomography. The inversion stops when the misfit matches the pick uncertainty. Cells below the depth of investigation are hatched, because the data do not constrain them.

segments.text: Quality control checks the picks, the timing, the geometry and the models. Each finding explains what was found and what to check; double-click it to open the trace. The summary is an aid to review, not a compliance statement.
segments.say: Quality control checks the picks, the timing, the geometry, and the models. Each finding explains what was found, and what to check; double click it to open the trace. The summary is an aid to review, not a compliance statement.

segments.text: Save the project with Ctrl+S. The project file holds the raw data, every processing step and pick, and the complete history, so the analysis can be reproduced and every change undone.
segments.say: Save the project with Control S. The project file holds the raw data, every processing step and pick, and the complete history, so the analysis can be reproduced, and every change undone.

segments.text: The built-in sample has a P line and an SH line. SH shots are recorded with a shear beam struck from the left and from the right. Refraction Studio combines each pair so that shear energy adds and P energy cancels, and picks the SH arrivals with a dedicated picker.
segments.say: The built in sample has a P line, and an S H line. S H shots are recorded with a shear beam struck from the left, and from the right. Refraction Studio combines each pair so that shear energy adds, and P energy cancels, and picks the S H arrivals with a dedicated picker.

segments.text: Engineering combines the shear-wave and P-wave models: Vs30, average velocities over chosen depth intervals, Poisson's ratio and the elastic moduli. Vs30 is reported only where the model reaches 30 m unless you choose to extrapolate, and estimates are always labelled.
segments.say: Engineering combines the shear wave and P wave models: V s 30, average velocities over chosen depth intervals, Poisson's ratio, and the elastic moduli. V s 30 is reported only where the model reaches thirty metres, unless you choose to extrapolate, and estimates are always labelled.

segments.text: Results summarises every line and compares analysis scenarios. Export the tables to Excel or CSV, the figures as PNG, SVG or PDF, and an audit record of the methods, settings and history.
segments.say: Results summarises every line, and compares analysis scenarios. Export the tables to Excel or C S V, the figures as P N G, S V G, or P D F, and an audit record of the methods, settings, and history.

segments.text: On the Report page, enter the report details and conclusions, choose the sections and add your company branding. Generate PDF report writes the complete technical report.
segments.say: On the Report page, enter the report details and conclusions, choose the sections, and add your company branding. Generate P D F report writes the complete technical report.

segments.text: The report covers the project and the survey configuration, shot gathers, travel-time curves, the layered and tomographic models, Vs30, the engineering parameters, quality control and processing notes, with the software version and settings for reproducibility.
segments.say: The report covers the project and the survey configuration, shot gathers, travel time curves, the layered and tomographic models, V s 30, the engineering parameters, quality control, and processing notes, with the software version and settings for reproducibility.

segments.text: Help is always one key away. Press Ctrl+K to find any command, F1 for help on the current page, or choose Explain this step. Guided mode shows a short guidance box on each page; Expert mode hides it.
segments.say: Help is always one key away. Press Control K to find any command, F 1 for help on the current page, or choose Explain this step. Guided mode shows a short guidance box on each page; Expert mode hides it.

segments.text: That is the complete workflow. Read the field guide before your first survey, and contact QuakeLogic support at any time at support@quakelogic.net.
segments.say: That is the complete workflow. Read the field guide before your first survey, and contact Quake Logic support at any time, at support at quake logic dot net.
